mode: built-in image_gen for stencil; SVG mask for paired template exports
prompt:
Create a clean FLAT BLACK-INK stencil illustration on a completely PURE WHITE OPAQUE background. NO TRANSPARENCY in this master sheet. One square icon, not a mockup. Use the attached app icon as the identity and composition reference: the SAME young headphone-wearing listener with lowered head at RIGHT, the NetEase spiral-note-shaped WHITE GAP among maple shapes at upper LEFT, and a small maple twig across the lower chest.
This will become a tiny single-ink tray icon. Draw it like a polished minimal black SVG stencil with smooth curves and VERY BROAD WHITE CUTOUTS, not a detailed anime illustration or pencil drawing. Black ink should cover only around 30 percent of the square. Use at most twelve substantial black line/shape groups. Lines approximately 4 percent of the canvas width; all gaps wide enough to remain open at 32px.
Right portrait: a single black hair silhouette with ONE generous white fringe cut; a thick black headphone band and black earcup ring with WHITE center; ONE clean black contour giving the gently lowered forehead/nose/jaw shape. Leave the ENTIRE FACE INTERIOR WHITE except one short black downturned eyelid. No hatching or grey shading. A single black neck/shoulder contour and simple collar V around a WHITE chest interior. Slim relaxed shoulders like the reference. One small maple twig with three attached simplified BLACK leaves at lower chest. Left motif: two or three broad BLACK organic maple-lobed masses leaving the recognizable NetEase spiral-note as a large uninterrupted WHITE negative-space gap in the same relative position. No dense leaf texture or fine veins, no stars, no dust, no stippling, no splatter, no paper texture. The WHITE SPACE must be absolutely smooth and empty. The BLACK SHAPES must be clean continuous solid ink. Keep the rounded-square overall footprint with plain WHITE outer corners, no outline frame, no black rectangular backdrop. No colors, no gradients, no semitransparency, no text, no watermark. Make the same person's icon into a strong screen-print-style stencil with ample negative space, not a photographic threshold or a generic headphone logo.
